description.narrative: The Project is expected to expand wastewater treatment capacity and reduce the discharge of untreated wastewater, contributing to improved environmental and public health outcomes. It also supports the use of PPP-based concession structures in municipal wastewater treatment, where private sector participation remains limited.

The proposed transaction involves investment in convertible preferred shares of Metito Utilities Limited (MUL or the Company), a leading mid-sized private company with an established track record in concession-based water and wastewater projects across emerging markets. The Company focuses on long-term PPP/BOOT projects with contracted cash flows, primarily in MENA, SubSaharan Africa, Central Asia, South Asia, and Emerging Europe. IFCs proposed investment in convertible preferred shares will strengthen MULs capital base, fund committed projects and pipeline growth and support the scaling of the private water PPP platforms in emerging market.
